Please advice . 2182 views Q. Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. Black Magic 9691 views Q. Recite Durood taaj 2943 views Q. Cancer Disease solution by Quran 34769 views Q. My boss is a Saudi person. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 164076 Country: india Title: for marriage Question: I am 21 years girl my parents are looking for suitable proposal for me but I am not getting any proposals. Alhamdulillah, i offer five times prayer with tahajjud and recite 36th ayat of 'Surah Yaseen’ after Isha prayer. Please give me any supplication or wazifah for my marriage please. (2) Please give me wazifah or dua for evil eye and i feel very depressed and anxiety about my marriage. Please reply me soon. Answer ID: 164076 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1277/1112/N=01/1440) (1) Offer two rakah Salatul Hajah after Isha salah in privacy daily and then read "يا بديع العجائب بالخير يا بديع" 101 time with durood 11-11 times before and after and then supplicate Allah wholeheartedly for suitable match. (Fatawa Mahmudia: 20: 89, 90, pub. Idarah Siddiq Dhabel) in-shaAllah, soon you shall get some suitable match. However, during your menses only read wazifah and then supplicate and don’t offer Salatul Hajah as it is not lawful for a woman to offer salah during her menses. Moreover, for suitable match some elders have suggested to read Surah Muzammil daily after Zuhar salah. However, Surah Muzammil should also be read only during the period you are free from menses not while experiencing menstruation cycle. May Allah arrange some suitable match for you! (2) Keep on reciting the following dua extensively in-shaAllah you shall be protected against evil eye: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أسَألُكَ مِنْ خَيْر مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ محمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم وأعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا استَعَاذَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم وأنتَ المُسْتَعانُ وَعَليْكَ البَلاَغُ وَلاَ حَولَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ باللهِ. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
